ex.en: Allan was lucky and passed the tax accountant examination.
ex.zh: 艾倫運氣很好，考過了稅務師考試。

ex.en: If he studied hard, he would pass the test.
ex.zh: 如果他用功讀書，就會通過考試。

ex.en: Excuse me, would you mind passing me the sugar?
ex.zh: 不好意思，可以把糖遞給我嗎？

ex.en: Please pass the salt.
ex.zh: 請把鹽遞給我。

ex.en: Time passes quickly when we're doing something we like.
ex.zh: 做喜歡的事時，時間過得特別快。

ex.en: Three years passed before we met again.
ex.zh: 三年過去了，我們才再次見面。

ex.en: I'm sorry to hear that your father passed away.
ex.zh: 聽到你父親過世的消息，我很難過。

ex.en: My grandmother passed away last year.
ex.zh: 我奶奶去年過世了。

ex.en: Check that your username and password are written correctly.
ex.zh: 請檢查使用者名稱和密碼是否輸入正確。

ex.en: Could you tell me the Wi-Fi password, please?
ex.zh: 可以告訴我 Wi-Fi 密碼嗎？

ex.en: The password isn't correct, so try again. Passwords are case-sensitive.
ex.zh: 密碼不正確，請再試一次。密碼有區分大小寫。

ex.en: Besides being an actress, she was a famous painter.
ex.zh: 她不只是演員，也是一位知名的畫家。

ex.en: Painters like Picasso are rare.
ex.zh: 像畢卡索這樣的畫家很少見。

ex.en: You are a good painter, aren't you?
ex.zh: 你是個很棒的畫家，不是嗎？

ex.en: We hired a painter to paint the living room.
ex.zh: 我們請了油漆工來粉刷客廳。

ex.en: The painters will finish the walls by Friday.
ex.zh: 油漆工會在星期五前把牆漆好。

ex.en: The restaurant offers free parking for patrons.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳提供顧客免費停車。

ex.en: Library patrons can borrow up to ten books.
ex.zh: 圖書館的讀者最多可以借十本書。

ex.en: She is a well-known patron of the arts.
ex.zh: 她是知名的藝術贊助人。

ex.en: The museum thanked its patrons for their support.
ex.zh: 博物館感謝贊助者的支持。

ex.en: He never brings the paycheck home.
ex.zh: 他從來不把薪水帶回家。

ex.en: I get my paycheck on the fifth of every month.
ex.zh: 我每個月五號領薪水。

ex.en: Many people live paycheck to paycheck.
ex.zh: 很多人都過著月光族的生活。

ex.en: I bought two packets of pistachios.
ex.zh: 我買了兩包開心果。

ex.en: She opened a packet of biscuits.
ex.zh: 她打開了一包餅乾。

ex.en: I'd like a packet of aspirin.
ex.zh: 我要一盒阿斯匹靈。

ex.en: I want to buy a pair of pants.
ex.zh: 我想買一條褲子。

ex.en: I don't need anything... just a new pair of pants.
ex.zh: 我什麼都不需要……只要一條新褲子。

ex.en: When I was little, I would only wear pants.
ex.zh: 我小時候只穿褲子。

ex.en: He ran too fast; when he stopped, he was panting.
ex.zh: 他跑得太快，停下來時氣喘吁吁。

ex.en: The dog was panting in the heat.
ex.zh: 那隻狗熱得直喘氣。

ex.en: She doesn't have as much patience as you do.
ex.zh: 她沒有你那麼有耐心。

ex.en: Mastering a foreign language calls for patience.
ex.zh: 精通一種外語需要耐心。

ex.en: A lot of our mistakes come from a lack of patience.
ex.zh: 我們很多錯誤都源於缺乏耐心。

payroll.zh: 員工名冊（on the payroll 受僱）

ex.en: We have 50 people on the payroll.
ex.zh: 我們有五十名員工。

ex.en: She has been on the payroll for ten years.
ex.zh: 她已經在公司任職十年了。

ex.en: Payroll is processed on the 25th of each month.
ex.zh: 薪資在每個月 25 號處理。

ex.en: The payroll department handles salary questions.
ex.zh: 薪資部門負責處理薪水相關問題。

ex.en: A crowd of people gathered to see the parade.
ex.zh: 一大群人聚集來看遊行。

ex.en: I caught sight of a parade on my way home.
ex.zh: 我在回家的路上看到一場遊行。

ex.en: The city holds a parade every New Year.
ex.zh: 這座城市每年新年都會舉辦遊行。

ex.en: The company applied for a patent on the new design.
ex.zh: 公司為新設計申請了專利。

ex.en: The patent expires next year.
ex.zh: 這項專利明年到期。

ex.en: He patented his invention in 2020.
ex.zh: 他在 2020 年為他的發明取得專利。

ex.en: You should patent your idea before showing it to investors.
ex.zh: 給投資人看之前，你應該先為你的點子申請專利。

ex.en: The invoice is payable within 30 days.
ex.zh: 這張發票須在三十天內付款。

ex.en: Rent is payable on the first day of each month.
ex.zh: 房租在每月一號支付。

ex.en: Please make the check payable to ABC Company.
ex.zh: 支票抬頭請寫 ABC 公司。

ex.en: Checks should be made payable to the hotel.
ex.zh: 支票抬頭應開給飯店。

ex.en: I use a frying pan at least once a day.
ex.zh: 我每天至少用一次平底鍋。

ex.en: Don't leave dirty pots and pans on the stove; wash them.
ex.zh: 別把髒鍋子放在爐子上，去洗乾淨。

ex.en: Heat some oil in a pan.
ex.zh: 在鍋裡把油燒熱。

ex.en: The movie was panned by critics.
ex.zh: 這部電影被影評人狠批。

ex.en: Critics panned the new phone.
ex.zh: 評論家給這款新手機很差的評價。

ex.en: Did you get the parcel I sent you?
ex.zh: 你收到我寄給你的包裹了嗎？

ex.en: The address on this parcel is wrong.
ex.zh: 這個包裹上的地址寫錯了。

ex.en: The parcel arrived faster than I thought it would.
ex.zh: 包裹比我想的還早到。

ex.en: Kids love pasta in tomato sauce.
ex.zh: 小朋友都喜歡番茄醬義大利麵。

ex.en: Do you eat pasta?
ex.zh: 你吃義大利麵嗎？

ex.en: There's often rice or pasta for lunch.
ex.zh: 午餐常常是飯或義大利麵。

ex.en: May I use your ink pad?
ex.zh: 可以借用一下你的印台嗎？

ex.en: Put a mouse pad under your mouse.
ex.zh: 在滑鼠下面放一個滑鼠墊。

ex.en: Keep a pad and pen by the phone.
ex.zh: 在電話旁邊放一本便條本和一支筆。

ex.en: She wrote the number on a pad of paper.
ex.zh: 她把號碼寫在便條紙上。

ex.en: Can you paraphrase the question in simpler words?
ex.zh: 你可以用比較簡單的話把問題重說一次嗎？

ex.en: Try to paraphrase the article in your own words.
ex.zh: 試著用你自己的話改寫這篇文章。

ex.en: Write a short paraphrase of this paragraph.
ex.zh: 把這一段改寫成簡短的版本。

ex.en: This is a paraphrase, not a direct quote.
ex.zh: 這是改述，不是直接引用。

ex.en: Is there a paperback edition of this book?
ex.zh: 這本書有平裝版嗎？

ex.en: I bought a paperback at the airport.
ex.zh: 我在機場買了一本平裝書。

ex.en: The paperback is much cheaper than the hardcover.
ex.zh: 平裝版比精裝版便宜很多。

ex.en: From childhood I dreamed of being a pastry cook.
ex.zh: 我從小就夢想當糕點師傅。

ex.en: This bakery sells delicious French pastries.
ex.zh: 這家麵包店賣很好吃的法式糕點。

ex.en: Roll the pastry into a rectangle.
ex.zh: 把麵糰擀成長方形。

ex.en: Bake the pie until the pastry is golden.
ex.zh: 把派烤到酥皮呈金黃色。

ex.en: This pamphlet is free of charge.
ex.zh: 這本小冊子是免費的。

ex.en: The pamphlet explains how to apply for a visa.
ex.zh: 這本小冊子說明如何申請簽證。

ex.en: It was only a partial success.
ex.zh: 那只算是部分成功。

ex.en: We received a partial refund for the cancelled tour.
ex.zh: 取消的行程我們拿到了部分退款。

ex.en: There will be a partial road closure this weekend.
ex.zh: 這個週末道路將部分封閉。

ex.en: I'm partial to dark chocolate.
ex.zh: 我特別喜歡黑巧克力。

ex.en: A judge should never be partial.
ex.zh: 法官絕不應該偏袒任何一方。

ex.en: She works as a paralegal at a law firm.
ex.zh: 她在律師事務所擔任律師助理。

ex.en: The paralegal prepared all the documents for the case.
ex.zh: 律師助理準備了這個案子的所有文件。

ex.en: You're partially correct.
ex.zh: 你說對了一部分。

ex.en: The road is partially closed for repairs.
ex.zh: 這條路因施工部分封閉。

ex.en: The project was partially funded by the government.
ex.zh: 這個專案有部分經費由政府提供。

ex.en: The meetings of the parliament are public.
ex.zh: 國會的會議是公開的。

ex.en: The President cannot disband the Parliament.
ex.zh: 總統不得解散國會。

par.zh: on (a) par with：與…同等、不相上下

ex.en: Our prices are on par with our competitors'.
ex.zh: 我們的價格和競爭對手差不多。

ex.en: His skills are on a par with senior engineers.
ex.zh: 他的能力和資深工程師不相上下。

par.zh: below par / not up to par：低於標準；身體不太舒服

ex.en: His work has been below par lately.
ex.zh: 他最近的工作表現不如水準。

ex.en: I'm feeling a bit below par today.
ex.zh: 我今天身體有點不舒服。

ex.en: The bonds were issued at par.
ex.zh: 這些債券按面額發行。

ex.en: The par value of each share is ten dollars.
ex.zh: 每股面額為十元。

parameter.zh: 參數；（限定範圍的）條件、界限

ex.en: You can change the parameters in the settings menu.
ex.zh: 你可以在設定選單裡更改參數。

ex.en: We must work within the parameters of the budget.
ex.zh: 我們必須在預算的範圍內做事。

ex.en: All that hard work finally had a big payoff.
ex.zh: 所有的努力終於有了豐厚的回報。

ex.en: The payoff from this investment may take years.
ex.zh: 這項投資可能要好幾年才看得到回報。

ex.en: The parliamentary election will be held in May.
ex.zh: 國會選舉將在五月舉行。

ex.en: The UK has a parliamentary system.
ex.zh: 英國採行議會制度。

payout.zh: 支付款項；（保險）理賠金、（股利）配發

ex.en: The insurance payout covered all the repairs.
ex.zh: 保險理賠金支付了所有維修費用。

ex.en: Shareholders received a large payout this year.
ex.zh: 股東今年獲得大筆配息。

ex.en: Watching TV is a passive activity.
ex.zh: 看電視是一種被動的活動。

ex.en: He has a passive character.
ex.zh: 他的個性很被動。

ex.en: It is clearly shown in Johnson's investigation that passive smoking is very harmful.
ex.zh: Johnson 的調查清楚顯示，二手菸非常有害。

ex.en: Change this sentence into the passive voice.
ex.zh: 把這個句子改成被動語態。

ex.en: The passive voice is common in formal reports.
ex.zh: 被動語態在正式報告中很常見。

ex.en: The payback period for the solar panels is about six years.
ex.zh: 這些太陽能板的回收期大約是六年。

ex.en: We expect a quick payback on this investment.
ex.zh: 我們預期這筆投資能很快回本。

ex.en: He said it was payback for what I did last year.
ex.zh: 他說這是對我去年所作所為的報復。

ex.en: This is payback for all the times you laughed at me.
ex.zh: 這是你每次笑我的報應。

ex.en: Women are still fighting for pay parity.
ex.zh: 女性仍在爭取同工同酬。

ex.en: The two currencies are now close to parity.
ex.zh: 這兩種貨幣的匯率現在接近一比一。

ex.en: The new model achieves parity with its rivals in features.
ex.zh: 新機型的功能已與競爭對手不相上下。

ex.en: The two companies signed a pact to share technology.
ex.zh: 兩家公司簽訂了技術共享協定。

ex.en: We made a pact to save money together.
ex.zh: 我們約好一起存錢。

ex.en: Bee stings can be very painful.
ex.zh: 被蜜蜂螫到可能會非常痛。

ex.en: My knee is still painful after the fall.
ex.zh: 跌倒之後我的膝蓋還是很痛。

ex.en: The truth can be more painful than a lie.
ex.zh: 真相可能比謊言更傷人。

ex.en: There's nothing more painful than losing one's child.
ex.zh: 沒有什麼比失去孩子更痛苦的事了。

ex.en: Tiny particles in the air can cause cancer.
ex.zh: 空氣中的微粒可能引發癌症。

ex.en: Dust particles can cause allergies.
ex.zh: 灰塵微粒可能引起過敏。

ex.en: A glass partition separates the two offices.
ex.zh: 一道玻璃隔板把兩間辦公室隔開。

ex.en: We put up a partition to create a small meeting room.
ex.zh: 我們加裝隔板，隔出一間小會議室。

partition.zh: 隔開、分割（空間；硬碟分割）

ex.en: The large room was partitioned into three offices.
ex.zh: 那個大房間被隔成三間辦公室。

ex.en: You can partition the hard drive into two sections.
ex.zh: 你可以把硬碟分割成兩個磁區。

ex.en: There's a patch on the knee of his jeans.
ex.zh: 他的牛仔褲膝蓋上有個補丁。

ex.en: Be careful, there are icy patches on the road.
ex.zh: 小心，路上有一塊塊結冰的地方。

ex.en: The company released a security patch.
ex.zh: 公司發佈了一個安全性修補程式。

ex.en: Install the latest patch to fix the bug.
ex.zh: 安裝最新的修補程式來修正這個錯誤。

ex.en: He has patched up the hole in the wall.
ex.zh: 他把牆上的洞補好了。

ex.en: I need to patch the hole in my jacket.
ex.zh: 我得把外套上的破洞補起來。

ex.en: Let's patch up our argument.
ex.zh: 我們別吵了，和好吧。

ex.en: They finally patched up their friendship.
ex.zh: 他們終於重修舊好。

ex.en: Paramilitary groups controlled the area for years.
ex.zh: 準軍事團體控制那個地區好幾年。

ex.en: The police have a paramilitary unit for emergencies.
ex.zh: 警方設有應付緊急狀況的準軍事單位。

ex.en: You do your part and I'll do the rest.
ex.zh: 你做你的部分，剩下的我來做。

ex.en: Part of the report is missing.
ex.zh: 報告少了一部分。

ex.en: We are making spare parts in a car factory.
ex.zh: 我們在一家汽車工廠生產備用零件。

ex.en: We are waiting for a spare part.
ex.zh: 我們在等一個備用零件。

ex.en: Are you planning to take part in the meeting?
ex.zh: 你們打算參加會議嗎？

ex.en: Over 200 companies took part in the trade fair.
ex.zh: 超過兩百家公司參加了這場商展。

ex.en: She played the part of a doctor.
ex.zh: 她飾演一名醫生。

ex.en: He had a small part in the movie.
ex.zh: 他在那部電影裡演一個小角色。

ex.en: They parted, never to see each other again.
ex.zh: 他們分開後就再也沒見過面。

ex.en: A fool and his money are soon parted.
ex.zh: 傻瓜很快就會把錢花光。

ex.en: Have you still not finished paying for my bike?
ex.zh: 你還沒付完我腳踏車的錢嗎？

ex.en: Can I pay by credit card?
ex.zh: 我可以刷卡嗎？

ex.en: This job pays 10,000 yen a day.
ex.zh: 這份工作一天的報酬是一萬日圓。

ex.en: He would be paid a small amount of money.
ex.zh: 他會拿到一小筆錢。

ex.en: You should pay more attention to what he says.
ex.zh: 你應該多注意他說的話。

ex.en: You should pay more attention to what you say.
ex.zh: 你應該多注意自己說的話。

ex.en: The pay is good, but the hours are long.
ex.zh: 薪水不錯，但工時很長。

ex.en: She got a pay raise last month.
ex.zh: 她上個月加薪了。

ex.en: All your hard work will pay off.
ex.zh: 你的努力都會有回報。

ex.en: Our marketing efforts finally paid off.
ex.zh: 我們的行銷努力終於有了成果。

ex.en: Let's forget the past.
ex.zh: 讓過去的事過去吧。

ex.en: In the past, people wrote letters by hand.
ex.zh: 過去，人們都用手寫信。

ex.en: We've been having strange weather the past few years.
ex.zh: 過去這幾年天氣一直很反常。

ex.en: I've learned a lot in the past three weeks.
ex.zh: 過去三週我學到了很多。

ex.en: His office is past the bank on your left.
ex.zh: 他的辦公室在過了銀行之後的左手邊。

ex.en: Walk past the bank and turn left.
ex.zh: 走過銀行後左轉。

ex.en: I have my supper at a quarter past seven.
ex.zh: 我七點十五分吃晚餐。

ex.en: I will sleep until it is half past eight.
ex.zh: 我要睡到八點半。

ex.en: Tom folded the paper before handing it to Mary.
ex.zh: 湯姆把紙折起來，再遞給瑪麗。

ex.en: Do you think that e-books will replace paper books?
ex.zh: 你覺得電子書會取代紙本書嗎？

ex.en: Can I have a piece of paper?
ex.zh: 可以給我一張紙嗎？

ex.en: The papers that were in the safe are gone.
ex.zh: 放在保險箱裡的文件不見了。

ex.en: Would you please have a look at these papers?
ex.zh: 可以請你看一下這些文件嗎？

ex.en: Is there any special news in today's paper?
ex.zh: 今天的報紙有什麼特別的新聞嗎？

ex.en: I read the paper every morning.
ex.zh: 我每天早上看報紙。

ex.en: I have to write a paper on climate change.
ex.zh: 我得寫一篇關於氣候變遷的報告。

ex.en: She presented a paper at the conference.
ex.zh: 她在研討會上發表了一篇論文。

ex.en: I have no particular reason to do so.
ex.zh: 我沒有特別的理由這麼做。

ex.en: I would like to place particular emphasis on this point.
ex.zh: 我想特別強調這一點。

ex.en: Is there a particular time that works for you?
ex.zh: 有沒有哪個特定時間你比較方便？

ex.en: Laura is very particular about her clothes.
ex.zh: 蘿拉對衣服很講究。

ex.en: I'm not very particular about food.
ex.zh: 我對吃不太講究。

ex.en: I want to emphasize this point in particular.
ex.zh: 我想特別強調這一點。

ex.en: I love Italian food, pasta in particular.
ex.zh: 我喜歡義大利菜，尤其是義大利麵。

ex.en: This new word is particularly important for us.
ex.zh: 這個新單字對我們特別重要。

ex.en: I love Nara, particularly in the fall.
ex.zh: 我很喜歡奈良，尤其是秋天的時候。

ex.en: The clothes at this boutique are particularly expensive.
ex.zh: 這家精品店的衣服特別貴。

ex.en: He spoke for ten minutes without a pause.
ex.zh: 他連續講了十分鐘都沒停頓。

ex.en: After a short pause, she continued her speech.
ex.zh: 短暫停頓後，她繼續演講。

ex.en: He paused to look at the poster.
ex.zh: 他停下來看海報。

ex.en: You can pause the video at any time.
ex.zh: 你可以隨時暫停影片。

ex.en: I don't like books with more than five hundred pages.
ex.zh: 我不喜歡超過五百頁的書。

ex.en: Tom ripped a page out of his sketch book.
ex.zh: 湯姆從素描本上撕下一頁。

ex.en: Please turn to page 25.
ex.zh: 請翻到第 25 頁。

ex.en: Please page Dr. Lee to the front desk.
ex.zh: 請廣播請李醫生到櫃台。

ex.en: I was paged at the airport.
ex.zh: 我在機場被廣播呼叫。

ex.en: She paged quickly through the magazine.
ex.zh: 她很快地翻閱了那本雜誌。

ex.en: I paged through the catalog during lunch.
ex.zh: 我午餐時翻閱了型錄。

ex.en: It is two miles from here to the park.
ex.zh: 從這裡到公園有兩英里。

ex.en: There were a lot of people in the park.

ex.zh: 修訂後的政策提供父親六週有薪陪產假。

ex.en: The new packaging protects the product during shipping.
ex.zh: 新包裝能在運送過程中保護產品。

ex.en: The team is testing recyclable packaging.
ex.zh: 團隊正在測試可回收包裝。

ex.en: He took a painkiller after the dentist removed his tooth.
ex.zh: 牙醫拔完他的牙齒後，他服用了止痛藥。

ex.en: Ask the pharmacist before combining this painkiller with other medicine.
ex.zh: 將這種止痛藥與其他藥物併用前，請先詢問藥師。

ex.en: Guests can have breakfast on the patio overlooking the garden.
ex.zh: 客人可以在俯瞰花園的露台享用早餐。

ex.en: The restaurant added heaters to its outdoor patio.
ex.zh: 餐廳在戶外露台加裝了暖爐。

ex.en: A passport is usually necessary when you travel overseas.
ex.zh: 海外旅行通常都要用到護照。

ex.en: She was in trouble because she lost her passport.
ex.zh: 她弄丟了她的護照，所以遇到了麻煩。

ex.en: I was asked to show my passport at the border.
ex.zh: 在邊境上，我被要求出示我的護照。

ex.en: He was born in a palace that isn't there any more.
ex.zh: 他出生在一個宮殿裡，那宮殿已經不存在了。

ex.en: The palace was heavily guarded.
ex.zh: 皇宮戒備森嚴。

ex.en: To hide the fact that she's a princess, she disguised herself as a boy and escaped the palace.
ex.zh: 她為了掩飾自己公主的身份，女扮男裝，逃出了皇宮。

ex.en: We will make the payment by bank transfer.
ex.zh: 我們會用銀行轉帳付款。

ex.en: Not being able to carry out payments on time can cause very large losses for the consumer.
ex.zh: 沒辦法按時付款，可能會讓消費者蒙受很大的損失。

ex.en: I knew that Tom was in his office doing paperwork.
ex.zh: 我知道湯姆在辦公室處理文書工作。

ex.en: I spent the whole afternoon doing paperwork.
ex.zh: 我整個下午都在處理文書工作。
